$schema.description: The schema of the circuit simulation configuration.

release.description: The release date of the configuration file. Date format is "yyyy/mm/dd".

author.description: The author of the configuration file.

dryRun.description: When true, generate oceanScript.il/plotScript.il/evaluationScript.il without executing any SKILL or Ocean commands. Confirms script content is correct before running actual simulation.

parameters.description: Global design parameters shared across all testbenches. Testbench-level parameters override these. Supports both object (unordered) and array (ordered) formats.

oneOf.description: Parameter array format (ordered execution - recommended when parameter order matters)
Array of simulation configuration file paths or objects (modular format). Extensions are optional and will be auto-completed to .sim.json

force.description: Force simulation to run even if results are up-to-date

baseParameters.description: Path to base parameters file (relative to main config). Extension is optional and will be auto-completed to .simParameters.json

parameters.description: Testbench-specific parameters. Supports both object (unordered) and array (ordered) formats.

oneOf.description: Parameter array format (ordered execution - recommended when parameter order matters)

analysis.description: List of analysis configurations in execution order

probe.description: Probe source instance path for stability analysis

localGround.description: Local ground net for stability analysis

outputStart.description: Time to start saving output data

parametricAnalysis.description: Parametric analysis sweep configurations. Array items are nested from outer to inner.

evaluation.description: Output expressions to evaluate against simulation results. Supports three formats: (1) evaluationList [{expression,name,plot,enable}] - unified format shared with xlConfig.tests[n].evaluation; (2) inline table {expressions,variables,metrics} - legacy inline format; (3) string - path to external .evaluation.json file.

savedSignals.description: Signals to save during simulation. Moved from simulation.{simulator}.output.savedSignals to testbench root level.

xlConfig.description: ADE XL mode configuration. When present, enables XL mode for managing multiple tests with corner/Monte Carlo analysis.

evaluationItem.description: A single named output expression. Used in both ADE L testbench and ADE XL test contexts.

expression.description: OCEAN expression string to evaluate against simulation results (e.g., VT(), cross(), value())

name.description: Name of this output used in results table

plot.description: Whether to plot this output expression in results

enable.description: Enable this expression. When false, the expression is skipped. Default true.

spec.description: Pass/fail specification limits for this expression. Used to generate ocnxlPut*Spec() calls and compute yield/cpk in evaluation.json.

min.description: Lower bound. Generates ocnxlPutGreaterthanSpec (or ocnxlPutRangeSpec if max also set).

max.description: Upper bound. Generates ocnxlPutLessthanSpec (or ocnxlPutRangeSpec if min also set).

evaluationList.description: List of named output expressions. Used in both ADE L testbench and ADE XL test contexts with the same format.

analysisOrder.description: Order of analysis execution. Available analysis types: tran, pz, dcmatch, stb, envlp, ac, dc, lf, noise, xf, sp, pss, pac, pstb, pnoise, pxf, psp, qpss, qpac, qpnoise, qpxf, qpsp, hb, hbac, hbstb, hbnoise, hbxf, sens, acmatch

suspended.description: Check in license when simulation is suspended.

shadowDatabase.description: Netlist text views from shadow OA database.

ignoreCheckUpdate.description: Ignore check update libraries and cells.

subckts.description: Set level of subcircuit to output.

useprobes.description: Select AC terminal currents to output.

outputFile.description: Output file name for ocean script. Relative paths are placed under output.directory/{libName}/{cellName}/{viewName}/{testbenchName}/{simulatorName}/. Default: oceanScript.il

evaluation.description: Inline evaluation configuration for simulation results

variables.description: Variable mapping for evaluation expressions. Keys are variable names, values are signal paths or result names.

expressions.description: Evaluation expressions - supports both object (unordered) and array (ordered) formats

oneOf.description: Expression object format (unordered execution). Keys are result names, values are SKILL expressions.
Expression array format (ordered execution - recommended when expressions depend on each other)

outputFile.description: Output file path for evaluation results. Passed as outputFile parameter to bvEvaluate.

resultsLocation.description: ADE XL results directory. Empty string or omit to use Cadence default.

simResultsLocation.description: Simulator results directory. Empty string or omit to use Cadence default.

xlMonteCarloOptions.description: ADE XL Monte Carlo simulation options. Controls sampling method, number of runs, early stopping, and output configuration for Monte Carlo analysis.

mcMethod.description: Monte Carlo variation type to include. 'all': both process and mismatch variations. 'process': process variations only (global parameter variations). 'mismatch': device mismatch variations only. 'global': global parameter variations.

mcNumPoints.description: Number of Monte Carlo sample points (runs) to simulate. String representation of integer (e.g. '100').

mcNumBins.description: Number of bins for early stopping significance test histogram. Empty string uses default.

mcStopEarly.description: Enable early stopping when convergence is detected. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

mcStopMethod.description: Method used for early stopping criterion (e.g. 'Significance Test').

samplingMode.description: Sampling strategy for MC runs. 'lds': low-discrepancy sequence (quasi-random, better coverage). 'random': pseudo-random sampling.

saveProcess.description: Save process variation parameters for each run. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

saveMismatch.description: Save mismatch variation parameters for each run. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

parasiticAnalysis.description: Include parasitic extraction in Monte Carlo runs. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

useReference.description: Use reference simulation result as baseline. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

donominal.description: Include nominal (zero-variation) run in MC results. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

saveAllPlots.description: Save waveform plots for all individual MC runs. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

monteCarloSeed.description: Random seed for reproducible Monte Carlo sampling. Empty string uses a random seed.

mcStartingRunNumber.description: Starting run number offset for MC simulation (for extending a previous run). Empty string starts from 1.

dumpParamMode.description: Dump sampled parameter values to output. Converted to 'yes'/'no' string by bvToYesNoString at runtime.

outputSummary.description: Configure which summary reports are generated after MC simulation completes.

yieldSummary.description: Generate yield summary report (pass/fail counts per specification).

exprSummary.description: Generate expression summary report (statistical summary of output expressions).

specSummary.description: Generate specification summary report (sigma margins per spec).

switchView.description: View switch list for AMS netlisting.

stopView.description: View stop list for AMS netlisting.

outputFile.description: Output file name for the generated Ocean script.

device.description: Device instance path for Component Parameter sweep

deviceParameter.description: Device parameter name for Component Parameter sweep

model.description: Model name for Model Parameter sweep

modelParameter.description: Model parameter name for Model Parameter sweep

device.description: Device instance path for Component Parameter sweep

deviceParameter.description: Device parameter name for Component Parameter sweep

model.description: Model name for Model Parameter sweep

modelParameter.description: Model parameter name for Model Parameter sweep

msOptimize.description: Enables the image to be imported in the Microsoft office application.

width.description: Sets the width of the image.

height.description: Sets the height of the image.

units.description: Sets the units for the width and height of the image.

resolution.description: Sets the image resolution. This option works only for the bmp, jpeg, png, ppm, tiff, and xpm file formats.

resolutionUnits.description: Sets the units for image resolution. This option works only for the bmp, jpeg, png, ppm, tif, and xpm file formats.

aspectRatio.description: Enables the aspect ratio, which is the ratio of the width of the image to its height.

enableTitle.description: Displays the trace title in the graph image.

enableLegend.description: Displays the trace legend in the graph image.

enableAxes.description: Displays the axes in the graph image.

enableGrids.description: Displays the grid in the graph image.

legendWidth.description: Global default signal name (legend) column width in pixels, applied to all subwindows that do not specify their own legendWidth. Passed to awvSetLegendWidth. Requires legend position to be set to left.

expandParamGroups.description: Global default for whether group/family traces are expanded (true) or collapsed (false) in plot windows. Applied via envSetVal before window creation. Applies to method=all and method=group. Per-result expandParamGroups overrides this value. Default: false (collapsed).

legendWidth.description: Signal name (legend) column width in pixels for this subwindow. Passed to awvSetLegendWidth to prevent signal names from being truncated. Requires legend position to be set to left.

expandParamGroups.description: Whether group/family traces are expanded (true) or collapsed (false) for this plot window. Applied via envSetVal before window creation. Overrides the global imageSettings.expandParamGroups. Applies to method=all and method=group. Default: false (collapsed).

plot_component.description: Plot option for the waveform. This option is ignored unless display mode is set to strip or composite.

plot_stripNumber.description: List of integers identifying the strips. If the value is -1, do not display the waveform.

display.description: The waveform name to be displayed in the trace legend.
The waveform name to be displayed in the trace legend.

timeX.description: The minimum duration of analog signal between high threshold and low threshold. It is used to determine the logic X.

releaseMemory.description: Specifies whether to internally release the memory of the analog waveform after converting it into a digital waveform.

parametric_analysis_range.description: Range configuration for parametric analysis sweep

parametric_analysis_step.description: Step configuration for parametric analysis sweep

numberOfSteps.description: Number of steps (for Number of Linear/Log/Decade/Octave Steps)

parametric_analysis_item.description: Single parametric analysis sweep item. Use range+step for sweep or values for discrete list.

values.description: Discrete value list. Generates paramAnalysis(?values list(...))

xlConfig.description: ADE XL configuration for managing multiple tests with corner/Monte Carlo analysis

library.description: Library name for XL session storage (adexl view location)

cell.description: Cell name for XL session storage (adexl view location)

view.description: View name for XL session storage (typically 'adexl')

environment.description: Local XL environment settings. Merged over global simulation.spectre.xlEnvironment; local values override global.

resultsLocation.description: ADE XL results directory. Empty string or omit to use Cadence default.

simResultsLocation.description: Simulator results directory. Empty string or omit to use Cadence default.

maxJobFail.description: Maximum number of job failures allowed

historyPrefix.description: Prefix for history item names created by OCEAN XL runs, passed to ocnxlHistoryPrefix(). Example: 'check' creates items like check.0, check.1, etc.

mode.description: ADE XL mode type passed to ocnSetXLMode(). null (default) calls ocnSetXLMode() with no argument. 'explorer' calls ocnSetXLMode("explorer"). 'assembler' calls ocnSetXLMode("assembler").

evaluationConfig.description: Configuration for post-simulation XL evaluation (evaluation.json generation). Applied when any test in xlConfig.tests has an evaluation array.

skipCommonParams.description: When true, disable extraction of common scalar params to top-level. Default false (extraction enabled). Common params are scalar params identical across ALL corners; they are moved to a top-level 'params' field to reduce per-corner redundancy.

evaluationOutput.description: Controls whether bvEvaluateXLPostSim runs after simulation. Unset (default): auto-detect based on evaluation expressions. true: force enable. false: force disable.

evaluationOutputMonteCarloSamples.description: When true, include raw sample arrays in MC evaluation.json output. Each sample is {value, pass} when spec is defined, or a plain number otherwise. Default false.

tests.description: List of test configurations to include in the XL session. Each entry references a testbench and specifies XL-specific settings (saved signals, output expressions).

testbench.description: Reference to testbench name defined in testbenches section

testName.description: XL test name used in ocnxlBeginTest(). Auto-generated as library:cell:index if not specified.

enable.description: Enable this test in XL session. Default true.

savedSignals.description: Signals to register for this test using ocnxlOutputSignal().

evaluation.description: Output expressions for this test. Same format as testbench-level evaluation for unified configuration across ADE L and ADE XL modes.

testName.description: Test name for this XL configuration (optional, defaults to testbench name)

runMode.description: XL run mode: corner or monteCarlo

sweeps.description: Global sweep variables applied to all tests

modelGroups.description: Model groups definition for corner analysis

models.description:
Model files and sections for this corner. The 'section' field supports three formats:
  Standard:  ["tt_mos", "ff_mos"]                - flat array of strings -> one corner entry
  Shorthand: [["setup_presim"], ["tt_mos", "ff"]]  - array of arrays -> one entry per sub-array
  Mixed:     ["setup_presim", ["tt_mos", "ff"]]    - strings and arrays -> one entry each

section.description: Section name(s). String or flat array = standard (one entry). Array containing sub-arrays or mixed string/array = shorthand (one entry per element).

oneOf.description: Standard (flat string array) or shorthand/mixed (array containing strings or sub-arrays)

modelGroup.description: Model group name to use for this corner

xAxisVariable.description: Specifies which variable in 'variables' becomes the x-axis of evaluation waveforms. This variable is placed last in the ocnxlCorner definition (innermost sweep loop), making it the x-axis. All other variables become family dimensions (outer loops). Use this to explicitly control x-axis selection, overriding non-deterministic JSON object key iteration order.

corners.description: List of corner names to disable

mcMethod.description: Statistical variation method for Monte Carlo runs. Default: all.

mcNumPoints.description: Number of points to simulate for Monte Carlo runs. Default: 100.

mcNumBins.description: Number of bins. Set when samplingMode is lhs. Default: "" (simulator calculates).

mcStopEarly.description: Stop Monte Carlo runs early when target is reached. Possible values: 0, 1.

mcStopMethod.description: Statistical variation method to stop Monte Carlo runs.

mcYieldTarget.description: Target yield percentage for Monte Carlo stop condition.

mcSigmaScaleValue.description: Sigma scale value for Monte Carlo runs.

samplingMode.description: Statistical sampling method for Monte Carlo runs. Default: random.

saveProcess.description: Save process parameters to results database. Default: 1.

saveMismatch.description: Save mismatch parameters to results database. Default: 0.

ignoreFlag.description: Skip mismatch variations for dutSummary instances. Default: 0.

parasiticAnalysis.description: Enable parasitic analysis for Monte Carlo runs. Default: 0.

useReference.description: Use schematic or reference point as starting place. Default: 0.

donominal.description: Run simulation at reference point before Monte Carlo. Default: 1.

saveAllPlots.description: Save raw psf files for every Monte Carlo iteration. Default: 0.

monteCarloSeed.description: Random seed for Monte Carlo runs. Default: 12345.

mcStartingRunNumber.description: Starting run number for Monte Carlo runs. Default: 1.

dumpParamMode.description: Dump parameter values to output. Possible values: yes, no.

dutSummary.description: List of DUT instances for mismatch variations (# separated). Default: "".

dutSubckts.description: List of DUT subcircuit instances (semicolon separated). Default: "".

designUnderTest.description: Design picked up for the test.

dutInstances.description: Number of occurrences of DUT instances.

plotWaveform.description: Waveform plot configuration: file path (string) or inline config (object)

oneOf.description: Path to waveform plot configuration file. Extension is optional and will be auto-completed to .waveform.json
Inline waveform plot configuration (same structure as waveform.schema.json 'waveform' property)
